style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: kraft cardboard wheel: kraft-paper keys in the card's own colour family, a magenta-marker Enter as the treat of the same paper world, butter soft keys, a very light panel; no red, no violet.

images.why: Look 'Two rings of letters one inside the other' and Student controls 'Inner ring: turns to set how many places on', 'Outer ring: holds the alphabet round a circle': the child turns a round card wheel, so the real object is a disc of cardboard with a BLANK face; every letter, tick, number and chord is drawn in code over it. Pale on purpose: vermilion partner lines and green coded letters are drawn over it and need a light ground.
images.prompt: A flat round disc of thick, light golden-cream card, matt and evenly toned, with a smooth unmarked top face, a softly rounded edge a little deeper in tone that shows the thickness of the card, a gentle top-light and a faint paper grain.
